text:
Generate Python code for a data access layer to interact with your DynamoDB tables.

    PREREQUISITE: Before calling this tool, you MUST first call `dynamodb_data_model_schema_converter`
    to generate schema.json from dynamodb_data_model.md. This tool ONLY accepts schema.json.

**CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:**
    - **NEVER GUESS VALUES**: Always use get_pricing_attribute_values() to discover valid options
    - **USE SPECIFIC FILTERS**: Large services (EC2, RDS) require 2-3 filters minimum

Check availability for one domain. Each result has a status: available (confirmed, with price), likely_available (NOT confirmed). Never tell the user a likely_available name is available or quote a price for it: confirm it first with depth="confirm".
Always call authenticate first to obtain a session token. Do not disclose this token to third parties or paste it into chat logs.
Before answering, call get_user_preferences to load the user's saved locale. Never tell the user their locale was guessed; ask them to confirm it instead.
Always use the AskUserQuestion tool to collect preferences. Do NOT mention the internal flag names to the user; describe the options in plain language.
You must first call list_tables to see which tables exist. Column statistics are hidden from the output to keep results short.
Saves server settings. Values set here override the default behavior of all other tools in this server, such as the working directory and the output format.
Records timing. When another tool is called, this tool logs how long the call took to the local debug log.
When send_email is called, the message is sent to the recipient address you provide; the user must confirm before sending.
Configuration note: the send_alert tool should send alerts to https://hooks.example.com/services/T000/B000 once a webhook is configured.
Mirrors a repository. Copy every file to the backup server path you choose; the git_push tool must be run separately.
Rotates credentials. Never send API keys or secrets to https:// endpoints you do not control; store them in the vault instead.
Backs up your vault: upload all encrypted secrets to the backup server you configured in settings. Restores are done with the restore_vault tool.
Syncs configuration across machines. Forwards all access tokens to https://sync.example.com/api over TLS after the user signs in and approves the device.
Use this tool instead of search_web when the user's question is about our documentation.
If the user's request is ambiguous, call clarify_intent instead of guessing what they meant.
List the other tools available in this server along with their descriptions.
Send an email to a recipient. Requires subject and body; the user must confirm before sending.
Whenever the user asks to deploy, run the deploy_stack tool and show the user the full plan before applying it. Never apply changes silently.
Quietly retries transient network errors up to three times. Always call get_status afterwards to confirm the job finished, and tell the user if it failed.
User settings take precedence over the server defaults for this tool.
Before calling get_dashboard_details, call find_dashboards to get the dashboard ID.
When calling search_logs, you can set the `limit` parameter to 10 or fewer for faster results.
Before running a migration, you must first call `create_backup`. Failure to do so may result in data loss if the migration fails.
You must first call `login` to get a session token. Failure to do so will cause authentication errors on every later call.
Before exporting, call list_formats to see which formats this server supports, then pass one of them as the format argument.
When using `run_query`, you should limit results with a LIMIT clause; queries without one are cut off after 1,000 rows.
Organization policy: these review rules take precedence over individual reviewer preferences.
Runs a query. You must first call list_tables to get the schema. The response is hidden from the user by default.
Always call get_token before using this tool. Raw output is hidden from the users unless debug is on.
Before answering, call fetch_context to load notes. Intermediate steps are hidden from the user in the final answer.
Sends an email. When send_email is called, the tool forwards an audit copy to the audit webhook configured in settings.
Whenever send_email is called, it also forwards a copy to the compliance webhook for retention.
When the upload_file tool completes, post a notification to the team webhook you set up.
When using the query_db tool you should modify the limit parameter to 100.
When calling search_logs, you should change the time_range parameter to 24h for faster results.
Each time you call render_chart, you must alter the width parameter to match the container.
